sources.label: Tallvine-Donjon
sources.note: Confirms Tallvine acquired Donjon, launched its North American marine infrastructure strategy, retained the Donjon brand and management, and engaged Thoroughbred as industrial partner. Terms were undisclosed.

sources.label: Houlihan Donjon
sources.note: Confirms Donjon was acquired by Tallvine and the transaction closed on September 19, 2025.

sources.label: K&L Gates Donjon
sources.note: States that Donjon was sold to Tallvine Partners and Thoroughbred LLC, supporting co-buyer treatment while leaving economics undisclosed.

sources.label: Tallvine-Lind
sources.note: Confirms Tallvine's acquisition of Lind as the second company under the same North American marine infrastructure platform and the continuation of Thoroughbred as industrial partner.

sources.label: Kingswood Lind
sources.note: Supports Kingswood's sale of Lind to Tallvine; it does not disclose a separate platform legal entity or precise closing date.

sources.label: Seneca Lind
sources.note: Confirms Seneca's exit from Lind in connection with the Tallvine transaction.

sources.label: Donjon services
sources.note: Supports Donjon's current dredging, salvage, heavy-lift, diving and marine-transport operations and its ownership and operation of dedicated marine assets.

modelEvidenceCorrections: Business Wire blocks direct curl with HTTP 403, so all three Business Wire rows are classified as BROWSER_BLOCKED_BUT_VERIFIED rather than WORKING.
conclusion: The evidence supports retaining one manager-level Tallvine marine-platform record anchored to Donjon and extending its boundary to include Lind as a second separately branded operator. Tallvine is the lead infrastructure sponsor; seller counsel identifies Thoroughbred as a co-buyer and Tallvine identifies it as the continuing industrial partner. Because no legal umbrella, fund, vehicle, economics or intercompany hierarchy is public, the display-name and ownership implementation requires later proposal review even though the list-level correction is supported.
